item.nusmp.ea_sword_of_rupture.card:
Genesis Grade longsword (305 damage, 1.5 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 60% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more.
While held: +4 attack damage, +12 maximum health, 30% less magic damage, the lent skill spatial attack resistance.
Rupture Slash (use; cooldown 22 s; 8% magicules): A wide cut of rupture: every foe in a 160 degree cone within 9 blocks takes 90% of Ea's damage and Weakness II for 8 seconds.
Space-Cut Wind (sneak + use; cooldown 60 s; 12% magicules): The sundered space: a line 36 blocks long, every foe on it takes 130% of Ea's damage and Slowness IV for 8 seconds.
Enuma Elish (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): The rupture of heaven and earth: every foe within 16 blocks takes 140% of Ea's damage and Weakness III for 10 seconds and is thrown back.
Tensura engravings: severance, barrier piercing, transcendence, ruination, magic interference.
item.nusmp.ea_sword_of_rupture.desc: The sword of rupture, three cylinders of black and gold that turn against each other: it was forged before the earth and heaven were parted, and it is the one that parted them. 60% more damage against a foe with 100 health or more. Use: Rupture Slash, Space-Cut Wind and Enuma Elish.
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Charm slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +5 luck, +8 maximum health, +20% maximum magicules, the lent skill analytical appraisal.
Spell Card: Leave (use; cooldown 30 s; 4% magicules): You step 32 blocks along your sight.
Spell Card: Reflection (use; cooldown 2 min; 10% magicules): A shield (about 100 health), Resistance II for 6 seconds, and every foe within 8 blocks is pushed away.
Spell Card: Magnetic Force (sneak + use; cooldown 2.5 min; 10% magicules): Every foe within 18 blocks is pulled to you and takes a 100 magic blow and Slowness IV for 8 seconds.

The binder of the game that was built to be won: a green book with forty slots for cards, and a pocket of spells that cannot be bought. Use: Spell Card Leave, Spell Card Reflection and Spell Card Magnetic Force.
item.nusmp.hogyoku_of_the_crystal_dissol:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Charm slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +35% maximum magicules, +12 maximum health, 45% less magic damage, 30% less curse damage, the lent skills magic resistance, self regeneration.
Fusion (use; cooldown 90 s; 10% magicules): The crystal fuses with you: Strength III and Regeneration III for 20 seconds, a shield and some life.
Boundary Dissolution (sneak + use; cooldown 3 min; 12% magicules): The boundary between things dissolves: every foe within 12 blocks takes a 130 magic blow and Weakness III for 8 seconds and is pushed back.
Transcendence (use; cooldown 10 min; 14% magicules; 1 a day): The crystal gives what you were about to become: Strength IV and Resistance III for 25 seconds, a great shield and 100 health back.
A crystal that dissolves the line between a soul and what it is meant to be, and gives to the one who holds it what it was about to become. Use: Fusion, Boundary Dissolution and Transcendence.
item.nusmp.law_of_cycles_gown.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn as a chestplate. Needs attunement.
While worn: +14 maximum health, +30% maximum magicules, 50% less magic damage, 60% less curse damage, the lent skills holy attack resistance, magic resistance.
Arrow of Hope (use; cooldown 30 s; 8% magicules): An arrow of light 40 blocks long: every foe on it takes a 160 magic blow and glows for 8 seconds.
Purify Despair (sneak + use; cooldown 3 min; 12% magicules): You and your friends within 16 blocks are cleansed of ailments, healed (80 for you) and given Regeneration III and Resistance II for 12 seconds.
Law of Cycles (use; cooldown 20 min; 14% magicules; 1 a day): The law rewrites the field: every foe within 20 blocks takes a 180 magic blow and Weakness III for 12 seconds and is pushed back.
item.nusmp.law_of_cycles_gown.desc: The long white and pink gown of a girl who became a law, so that no one has to despair. It turns curses aside and mends those who stand near. Use: Arrow of Hope, Purify Despair and Law of Cycles.
item.nusmp.millennium_eye.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn as a helmet. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
While worn: +4 luck, +20% maximum magicules, 30% less magic damage, the lent skills eye of truth, magic sense, farsight.
Mind Read (use; cooldown 45 s; 8% magicules): Every foe within 24 blocks glows through the walls for 12 seconds and is marked as read (you deal 25% more to it); you borrow the future vision for 12 seconds.
Truth Gaze (sneak + use; cooldown 2.5 min; 12% magicules): A beam of light 32 blocks long: every foe on it takes a 130 magic blow, Weakness III for 8 seconds and the read mark.
Seal in a Card (use; cooldown 2 min; 12% magicules; 6 a day): The mob in your sights within 24 blocks (not a boss, not a player) has its soul sealed in a card for 8 seconds: it cannot move or strike, glows and takes 25% more from you; a boss or a player only falters.
Sight of the Dead (use; cooldown 90 s; 8% magicules): Every undead and every dying foe (under 25% health) within 32 blocks glows through the walls for 12 seconds and is marked as read; you see in the dark and sense magic for 12 seconds.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_eye.desc: The Sennen Eye: a round golden disc with an eye, worn on the brow. It reads minds, looks into a soul, seals souls inside cards and shows the dead. Carried by Aknadin, then Pegasus, Bakura and Yugi. Use: Mind Read, Truth Gaze, Seal in a Card and Sight of the Dead. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_key.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Belt slot. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
Passive: No fear, confusion, insanity, hypnosis, sleep, nausea or darkness can stay on you.
While worn: +10 maximum health, +2 luck, 50% less curse damage, the lent skill abnormal condition resistance.
Open the Soul Room (use; cooldown 90 s; 8% magicules): Every foe within 12 blocks loses its good effects, takes a 95 magic blow and Weakness II for 8 seconds; you and your friends within 12 blocks are cleared of fear, confusion and the like.
Mind Garden (use; cooldown 5 min; 12% magicules; 2 a day): You and your friends within 14 blocks are cleansed of ailments, healed (60 for you, half for friends) and given Regeneration III and Resistance II for 12 seconds.
Redecorate the Soul (sneak + use; cooldown 5 min; 16% magicules; 2 a day): The mob in your sights within 20 blocks (not a boss, not a player) has its soul redecorated: it is your puppet for 60 seconds and hunts its own kind.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_key.desc: The Sennen Key: a golden ankh that lets its holder walk into another person's mind and redecorate the soul until anyone is a puppet. No fear, confusion or sleep can reach the one who carries it. Carried by Shimon Muran and Shada, then Shadi and Yugi. Use: Open the Soul Room, Mind Garden and Redecorate the Soul. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_necklace.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn as a chestplate. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
Passive: Once every 8 seconds the first blow of 3 or more is seen coming and halved.
While worn: +14 maximum health, +5% movement speed, 35% less magic damage, 30% less projectile damage, the lent skill danger sense.
Foresight (use; cooldown 75 s; 8% magicules): For 12 seconds: Speed II, Resistance II and a shield, every foe within 24 blocks glows, and the future vision is lent to you.
Prophecy (sneak + use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): You are mended for 60% of the health you are missing and cleansed, take almost no damage for 3 seconds (Resistance IV) and gain a shield for 10 seconds.
Sight of the Past (use; cooldown 75 s; 8% magicules): Whoever last hurt you (within the last minute) and every foe within 32 blocks that has you in its sights glows through the walls for 12 seconds and is marked as read; you borrow the future vision.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_necklace.desc: The Sennen Necklace: a golden collar with an eye plate that sees into the past and the future. Once every eight seconds the first heavy blow is seen coming and halved. Carried by Isis, then Mr. Ishtar, Ishizu and Yugi. Use: Foresight, Prophecy and Sight of the Past. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_puzzle.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Neck slot. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
Passive: When a blow would kill you, the other soul takes it: you wake at 40% health with Resistance IV for 3 seconds and a shield (once every 5 minutes).
While worn: +12 maximum health, +25% maximum magicules, +3 luck, 40% less magic damage, 50% less curse damage, the lent skill thought acceleration.
Other Me (use; cooldown 90 s; 10% magicules): The other soul steps forward: Strength III and Resistance II for 20 seconds and an absorbing shield.
Shadow Game (sneak + use; cooldown 4 min; 14% magicules; 3 a day): A game of shadows: every foe within 14 blocks (up to 12) takes a 110 magic blow, Slowness IV, Weakness II and Glowing for 8 seconds and is marked (you deal 20% more to it while the mark lasts); you gain Resistance I and a shield.
Duel Monster (use; cooldown 5 min; 16% magicules; 3 a day): A Duel Monster answers the Puzzle: one spectral monster (an iron golem, or a skeleton where there is none) fights for you for 45 seconds with Strength II; at most six allies of yours at once.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_puzzle.desc: The Sennen Puzzle: an inverted golden pyramid with the Eye of Wdjat on its face, holding the soul of Pharaoh Atem. When a blow would kill you, the other soul takes it and you wake at 40% health (once in five minutes). It summons and commands Duel Monsters and gives its solver the power of darkness. Carried by Aknamkanon, Atem and Priest Seto, then Solomon Muto and Yugi Muto. Use: Other Me, Shadow Game and Duel Monster. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_ring.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Hands slot. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
Passive: A monster that hunts you within 24 blocks glows through the walls for 3 seconds, so it is never a surprise.
While worn: +30% maximum magicules, +1 reach, 30% less magic damage, the lent skill magic sense.
Dowsing Needles (use; cooldown 30 s; 6% magicules): Every hostile within 48 blocks glows for 10 seconds, and you sense magic for 30 seconds.
Draw Power (use; cooldown 2 min; 6% magicules): Every foe within 12 blocks (up to 12) takes an 80 magic blow; you take back 4% of your maximum magicules for each (24% at most) and some life.
Seal a Soul (use; cooldown 60 s; 10% magicules; 8 a day): The soul of the mob in your sights within 16 blocks (not a boss, not a player, at most 120 health) is sealed in the Ring: it dies, you take back 8% of your maximum magicules and some life; a greater soul only takes a 150 magic blow.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_ring.desc: The Sennen Ring: a golden hoop round a pyramid, hung with five needles that swing to whatever its owner seeks, like a compass. It seals souls, or pieces of souls, into objects and holds the souls of Zorc and Thief Bakura. Monsters that hunt you glow through the walls. Carried by Mahad, Thief King Bakura and Zorc, then Marik, Bakura and Yugi. Use: Dowsing Needles, Draw Power and Seal a Soul. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_rod.card:
Genesis Grade staff (300.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second). Needs no attunement.
Passive: 70% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health, which it also weakens (Weakness II for 6 seconds).
While held: +1 reach, +25% maximum magicules, 40% less magic damage, the lent skill thought acceleration.
Mind Control (use; cooldown 60 s; 10% magicules): The mob in your sights within 24 blocks (not a boss, not a player) is yours for 12 seconds and hunts its own kind; a boss or a player only falters (Slowness IV, Weakness II for 4 seconds).
Pharaoh's Command (sneak + use; cooldown 2 min; 12% magicules): Up to three mobs within 16 blocks (no boss, no player) bend to your will for 8 seconds.
Judgement Strike (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): A line of light 28 blocks long: every foe on it takes a heavy blow (1.2 times the rod's damage) and Slowness IV for 6 seconds.
Seal in a Tablet (use; cooldown 2.5 min; 14% magicules; 4 a day): Up to three mobs on a line 24 blocks long (no boss, no player) are sealed in stone tablets for 12 seconds: they cannot move or strike and cannot be hurt much; a boss only falters.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
Tensura engravings: magic weapon, magic interference, barrier piercing, enervation, soul eater.
item.nusmp.millennium_rod.desc: The Sennen Rod: a golden rod with a crescent head and an eye, that bends the mind of whoever it is pointed at and seals spirit monsters in stone tablets. 70% more damage against a foe under 30% of its health, which it also weakens. Carried by Priest Seto, then Mr. Ishtar, Marik and Yugi. Use: Mind Control, Pharaoh's Command, Judgement Strike and Seal in a Tablet. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.millennium_scale.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Charm slot. Needs no attunement (so the whole Millennium set can be worn at once).
While worn: +4 luck, +10 maximum health, 40% less magic damage, 40% less curse damage, the lent skill analytical appraisal.
Weigh the Heart (use; cooldown 75 s; 10% magicules): The monster in your sights (24 blocks) has its heart weighed against the feather: an undead, a demon, a boss or any monster takes a 150 magic blow, Weakness III for 10 seconds and the weighed mark (+30% damage from you for 12 seconds); an animal, a villager or a player is spared.
Ammit's Verdict (sneak + use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): Every monster within 14 blocks is weighed at once (120 magic damage each, marked, glowing); you are mended 12 for every heart devoured, up to five.
Fuse Monsters (use; cooldown 3 min; 14% magicules; 4 a day): Up to five foes within 16 blocks are pulled together and fused in one blow: a 110 magic blow each, 20% harder for every other foe in the knot, Slowness IV for 5 seconds and the weighed mark.
Millennium set (the seven items are worn together: the Puzzle at the neck, the Eye as a helmet, the Ring on the hand, the Rod in the hand, the Key on the belt, the Scale as a charm, the Necklace as a chestplate; none needs attunement): with 3 pieces Resistance I; 4, Regeneration I; 5, Strength I; 6, Speed I; all 7 make those Resistance II, Regeneration II and Strength II. The damage and healing of every Millennium act grow by 5% for each piece worn beyond the first (30% with all seven).
item.nusmp.millennium_scale.desc: The Sennen Scale: a golden balance that weighs the darkness in a person's heart, and fuses monsters. A heavy heart is struck down, a light one is spared. Carried by Karim, Thief King Bakura and Atem, then Shadi and Yugi. Use: Weigh the Heart, Ammit's Verdict and Fuse Monsters. Worn with the other Millennium Items it grows stronger.
item.nusmp.requiem_stand_arrow.card:
Genesis Grade dagger (260 damage, 2.2 attacks a second). Needs attunement.
Passive: 80% more damage while you are under 40% of your health; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life.
While held: +0.4 attack speed, +10 maximum health, 30% less magic damage, the lent skill danger sense.
Piercing Requiem (use; cooldown 20 s; 8% magicules): A thrust of gold 20 blocks long: every foe on it takes 110% of the arrow's damage and glows for 8 seconds.
Return to Zero (sneak + use; cooldown 90 s; 10% magicules): Everything returns to zero: a shield, Resistance II for 6 seconds, your ailments cleansed, and every foe within 6 blocks thrown back.
Stand Awakened (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): Strength IV and Speed III for 20 seconds, a shield and some life (40% of the arrow's damage).
Tensura engravings: severance, soul eater, energy steal, enervation, transcendence.
item.nusmp.requiem_stand_arrow.desc: A golden arrow with a beetle's head, the one that wakes what sleeps in a soul. What it pierces is returned to zero. 80% more damage while you are under 40% of your health; 5% of the damage comes back to you as life. Use: Piercing Requiem, Return to Zero and Stand Awakened.
item.nusmp.seven_dragon_balls_of_shenron:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Belt slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +16 maximum health, +3 luck, 30% less curse damage, the lent skills self regeneration, strengthen body.
Dragon Radar (use; cooldown 30 s; 4% magicules): Every hostile within 48 blocks glows for 12 seconds, and you sense magic for 32 seconds.
Eternal Dragon's Roar (sneak + use; cooldown 75 s; 10% magicules): A roar of the eternal dragon: every foe on a line 32 blocks long takes a 150 magic blow and Slowness III for 6 seconds.
Shenron's Wish (use; cooldown 20 min; 14% magicules; 1 a day): One wish: you are healed in full, your ailments are cleansed, you gain a great shield, Regeneration III for 10 seconds and Strength II for 30 seconds, and your friends within 12 blocks gain Regeneration III and absorption.

A belt-pouch with the seven orange spheres, one star to seven. Together they call the eternal dragon, who makes one wish: it makes the wearer whole, once a day. Use: Dragon Radar, Eternal Dragon's Roar and Shenron's Wish.
item.nusmp.straw_hat_of_joy_boy.card:
Genesis Grade relic, worn as a helmet. Needs attunement.
While worn: +10 maximum health, +50% knockback resistance, +8% movement speed, 80% less lightning damage, 90% less fall damage, 30% less explosion damage.
Gear Fifth (use; cooldown 2 min; 12% magicules): Speed IV and Strength III for 24 seconds and a shield: the body laughs at the rules.
Rubber Bajrang (sneak + use; cooldown 40 s; 8% magicules): A stretch of rubber: you rush 14 blocks and every foe on the way takes a 150 blow and Slowness III for 4 seconds.
Drums of Liberation (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): Every friend within 16 blocks gains Strength II and Speed II for 30 seconds, and you are mended.
item.nusmp.straw_hat_of_joy_boy.desc: A worn straw hat with a red band, the promise of a man who laughed at the end of the world. The wearer is hard to hurt, hard to hold down and glad of it: lightning, falls and explosions mean little. Use: Gear Fifth, Rubber Bajrang and Drums of Liberation.
item.nusmp.truth_seeking_orbs_of_the_sag:
Genesis Grade relic, worn in the Back slot. Needs attunement.
While worn: +30% maximum magicules, +10 maximum health, 40% less magic damage, 50% less projectile damage, the lent skills magic sense, thought acceleration.
Truth-Seeking Barrage (use; cooldown 25 s; 8% magicules): Eight black orbs fly at the nearest foes in front within 30 blocks: a 110 magic blow each, Slowness II for 4 seconds.
Shinra Tensei (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s; 10% magicules): The push of the world: every foe within 14 blocks takes a 120 magic blow and Slowness III for 6 seconds and is thrown far back.
Chibaku Tensei (use; cooldown 5 min; 14% magicules; 2 a day): A planetoid of gravity: every foe within 16 blocks is pulled in and takes a 140 magic blow and Slowness V for 10 seconds.

Nine black orbs that float behind the shoulders of whoever carries the sage's power. They turn aside what is thrown, push the world away and pull it in. Use: Truth-Seeking Barrage, Shinra Tensei and Chibaku Tensei.
